manual_all_steps: Open RU/conflict_drop_cache.txt from the Project tree, wait for the conflict dialog, confirm both rows are present, and choose Drop cache.

Use General -> Save, open neutral RU/ui.txt, verify it opens without a conflict dialog, switch back to RU/conflict_drop_cache.txt, and verify file-side values remain visible with no second conflict prompt.
Open RU/conflict_drop_original.txt from the Project tree, wait for the conflict dialog, confirm both rows are present, and choose Drop original.

Use General -> Save, open neutral RU/ui.txt, verify it opens without a conflict dialog, switch back to RU/conflict_drop_original.txt, and verify cached values remain visible with no second conflict prompt.
Open RU/conflict_merge_mixed.txt from the Project tree, wait for the conflict dialog, choose Merge, and confirm both MERGE_A and MERGE_B rows are visible.
Select Original for MERGE_A, Cache for MERGE_B, edit one merge value cell before Apply, and then press Apply.

Use General -> Save, open neutral RU/ui.txt, verify it opens without a conflict dialog, switch back to RU/conflict_merge_mixed.txt, and verify the mixed choices plus edited merge value remain visible with no second conflict prompt.
manual_checked_expected_checks: Conflict dialog appears immediately for RU/conflict_drop_cache.txt, RU/conflict_drop_original.txt, and RU/conflict_merge_mixed.txt.
Drop cache clears cached draft data and leaves file-side values visible for RU/conflict_drop_cache.txt.
Drop original applies cached values for RU/conflict_drop_original.txt.
Merge requires per-row decisions, allows one edited merge value, and applies the mixed result for RU/conflict_merge_mixed.txt.
RU/ui.txt stays a neutral non-conflicting switch target while save plus file switching remains stable after each conflict path.
